steps.description: A referee testimonial is a letter from someone who knows you and can speak about your character.

overrides.content:
Each testimonial should include:

- the name, address and telephone number of the person writing the letter
- what you do well
- what you could improve
- your behaviour
- how you get along with others

steps.title: Application submitted
steps.markdownContent:
## What happens next

BYAC will review your application and contact you about an interview.

Bring your original documents to the interview.

If you are under 16, your parent or guardian must attend the interview with you.

## If you need help

Telephone: (246) 535-0180

Email: byac@barbados.gov.bb

Have your application reference number ready when contacting us.
